Available device IDs
Every device on a BACnet system needs its own unique number, its Device ID. This page shows which IDs are already taken and which are still available, so you can pick a safe one for a new device.

Available network numbers
Each separate BACnet network (a trunk of devices behind a router) needs its own unique network number. This page shows which numbers are already taken and which are still available, so a new network does not clash with an existing one.
